enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain asleep. Turn to other side. Stretch leg. Sigh. At 06:30, open eyes. Rub eyes. Sit up. Swing legs over edge of bed.

Stand up from bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out cereal box. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open drawer. Take out spoon. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from glass. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Stand in front of mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check bag contents. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workplace. Greet colleagues. Put on scrubs. Check schedule. Attend morning meeting. Examine patients. Record notes. Administer medication. Assist doctor. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Update patient charts. Clean equipment. Handover to next shift. Clock out. Leave workplace.

Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil to pan. Add vegetables to pan. Stir vegetables. Add meat to pan. Cook food. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear dishes. Wash dishes. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat snack. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for boot. Type password. Open browser. Browse websites. Check emails. Type reply. Close browser. Shut down laptop. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn pages. Close book. Put book down.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water. Adjust temperature. Undress. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Pick up book. Read book. Turn pages. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down in bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes.
Lie in bed. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain asleep. Turn to other side. Stretch leg. Sigh. Remain asleep.
